emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_.name: emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_check
emails_transactionnels_entite_coherence_.value:
("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'reservation' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'reservation_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'demande' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'demande_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'message' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'message_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'utilisateur' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'utilisateur_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'abonnement' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'abonnement_%')
        OR ("emails_transactionnels"."entite_type" = 'paiement' AND "emails_transactionnels"."type" LIKE 'paiement_%')

emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check.name: emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check
emails_transactionnels_erreur_code_check.value:
"emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code" IS NULL OR (
        char_length("emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 64
        AND "emails_transactionnels"."erreur_code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9_]+$'
      )

evenements_paiement_ids_check.name: evenements_paiement_ids_check
evenements_paiement_ids_check.value:
char_length("evenements_paiement"."id_transaction") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND ("evenements_paiement"."external_id" IS NULL OR char_length("evenements_paiement"."external_id") <= 100)

generations_ia_a_purger_idx.name: generations_ia_a_purger_idx
generations_ia_a_purger_idx.where: "generations_ia"."entree" IS NOT NULL OR "generations_ia"."sortie" IS NOT NULL

paiements_montants_check.name: paiements_montants_check
paiements_montants_check.value:
"paiements"."montant_plan" > 0 AND "paiements"."montant" >= "paiements"."montant_plan" AND "paiements"."montant" <= 1000000000
        AND "paiements"."frais_estimes" >= 0 AND "paiements"."net_estime" = "paiements"."montant" - "paiements"."frais_estimes"
        AND ("paiements"."frais_reels" IS NULL OR "paiements"."frais_reels" >= 0) AND ("paiements"."net_reel" IS NULL OR "paiements"."net_reel" >= 0)

paiements_telephone_masque_check.name: paiements_telephone_masque_check
paiements_telephone_masque_check.value:
"paiements"."telephone_masque" IS NULL
        OR (char_length("paiements"."telephone_masque") <= 32 AND position('•' in "paiements"."telephone_masque") > 0)

paiements_ids_check.name: paiements_ids_check
paiements_ids_check.value:
("paiements"."id_fournisseur" IS NULL OR char_length("paiements"."id_fournisseur") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        AND ("paiements"."reference_fournisseur" IS NULL OR char_length("paiements"."reference_fournisseur") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

progressions_inscription_validation_chec.name: progressions_inscription_validation_check
progressions_inscription_validation_chec.value:
"progressions_inscription"."proposition_validee_le" IS NULL
        OR ("progressions_inscription"."accroche" IS NOT NULL AND "progressions_inscription"."presentation" IS NOT NULL AND "progressions_inscription"."services_proposes" IS NOT NULL)

services_prix_tarif_check.name: services_prix_tarif_check
services_prix_tarif_check.value: ("services"."tarif" = 'payant') = ("services"."prix_montant" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."prix_devise" IS NOT NULL)
